facts.business: Bharat Rasayan Limited manufactures and sells agrochemical formulations including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and plant growth regulators for domestic and international markets.
key_risks: Dependence on monsoon and weather conditions affecting crop acreages and pest incidence
Volatility in raw material prices due to geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions
Regulatory changes and compliance requirements leading to delays in approvals
Seasonal nature of demand and unpredictability of pest attacks
Global consolidation in crop protection industry and probable ban on select active ingredients
High inventory provisions amidst falling raw material costs and higher sales returns
facts.related_party_note: Material Related Party Transaction with M/s B R Agrotech Limited (KMP/their relatives have significant influence) amounting to 227.25 Crores (18.60% of turnover) at arm's length basis, approved by Audit Committee and placed for member approval.
